summary_bullets: Make final-summary delivery explicitly visible in orchestrator chat text for /design and /implement.
Guard the prompt surface against Bash-fence marker extraction and Bash cat summary emission regressions.
commit_message:
Clarify final-summary chat emission

Require /design and /implement final-summary bodies to be emitted as orchestrator text instead of Bash or Python tool output. Add structure pins that reject final-summary markers inside Bash fences and guard against reintroducing the Bash cat summary path.
